book.name: Ola Saam
book.title: Ola Saam Ola Song En Preya Langa God

content.text: YAWEI, ai kaman langa yu blanga kipum mi seifwan.
Nomo larram enibodi meigim mi sheim.
Dumaji yu oldei dum wanim rait, album mi en seibum mi.
Irrim mi en seibum mi.
YAWEI, yu jidan jis laiga bigwan ston weya ai gin go enitaim blanga jidan seifwan.
Yu main seifwan haus en yu fait blanga mi.
Main God, yu seibum mi brom ola nogudbala pipul,
en brom det pawa blanga ola krulwan en brabli nogudwan pipul.
YAWEI yu det boswan God. Ai libum ebrijing langa yu.
Aibin trastimbat yu brom yang taim.
Ol main laif aibin larram yu hendulum ebrijing.
Yubin maindimbat mi olawei brom det taim wen aibin bon.
Ai garra preisimbat yu olataim.
Main laif shoum loda pipul,
yu na strongwan en yu oldei lukaftumbat mi.
Mi preisimbat yu oldei.
Mi tokabat yu dumaji yu brabli haibalawan.
Nomo libum mi dumaji mi olbala.
Nomo libum mi na dumaji mi wikwan.
Main enami olabat wandim kilim mi ded.
Olabat tokabat blanga wanim dei garra dum langa mi.
Olabat tok, “God bin libum im na.
Wi garra go en gedim im. Nobodi kaan seibum im.”
God, nomo jidan longwei.
Kaman kwikbala en album mi.
Yu nomo larram detlot hu kaman blanga fait langa mi win. Yu binijap olabat.
Yu meigim detlot hu wandi ardim mi, sheim brabliwei.
Ai garra oldei trastim langa yu blanga ebrijing.
Ai garra kipgon preisimbat yu.
Ai garra dalimbat ola gudbala ting weya yu oldei dumbat blanga seibum yu pipul olabat,
nomeda ai nomo sabi ebrijing weya yubin dum.
YAWEI, yu na det brabli strongwan God,
en yu na bin dum detmatj ting garram yu pawa.
Ai garra tokabat blanga yu dumaji yu trubala.
Oni yu na ai garra preisim.
Main God, brom wen aibin lilwan yubin titjim mi,
en raidap tudei mi stil dalimbat pipul blanga ola gudwan ting weya yu oldei dumbat.
Main God, nomo libum mi dumaji mi olwan en mi garram greiwan heya.
Jidan garram mi wen mi toktokbat blanga yu pawa langa ola biginini, en olabat bigininimob wen dei garra kaman bambai.
Blanga yu raitwei im gajimap det skai. Yubin dum loda haibalawan ting.
Nobodi jidan wulijim yu, najing.
Yubin meigim trabul kaman langa mi en aibin ardim, bat yu garra meigim mi strongbala igin.
Yu kaan larram mi go langa greibyad.
Yu garra meigim mi jidan mowa haibalawan igin.
Yu garra meigim mi jidan gudbinjiwei igin.
Ai garra preisim yu garram gita.
Blanga det trubalawei blanga yu ai garra preisim yu, main God.
Garram main gita ai garra plei ola song langa yu, det holiwan God blanga Isreil.
Ai garra jingat gudbinjiwei wen mi preisim yu.
Brabliwei na ai garra sing dumaji yubin baiyimbek mi.
Oldei ai garra tokabat blanga det raitwei blanga yu,
dumaji ol detlot hubin wandim trai kilim mi,
dei nomo bin win en dei jidan brabli sheim na.
